description.content:
View Payroll Sheet
Returns the complete payroll sheet data (Çarşaf Bordro) for a given payroll run as JSON. This is the API equivalent of the Excel export.

Scope: payroll-sheet:view

Request
POST /v2/payroll-sheet/view/{id}

Parameter
Type
Required
Description

id
string
Yes
32-char payroll ID

Body
{
  "filter": {
    "search": "Ahmet",
    "status": ["ended"],
    "salaryPeriod": ["monthly"],
    "insuranceId": ["setting_id"],
    "taxId": ["setting_id"],
    "expenseCenterId": ["setting_id"],
    "units": [["unit_item_id"]]
  }
}

All filter fields are optional. Send {} to get all employees.

Filters
filter.search
string — Free text search by employee full name. Supports Turkish characters.

filter.status
array — Filter by one or more statuses (OR logic).

Value
Description

ended
Calculation completed, payslip not created

started
Calculation in progress

failed
Calculation failed

hasPayslip
Payslip created

isPayslipPublic
Payslip published to employee

changedColumns
Employee data changed since last calculation

activeEmployee
No termination date

terminatedEmployee
Has termination date

filter.salaryPeriod
array — Filter by salary period type.

Value
Description

monthly
Aylık

hourly
Saatlik

attendance_fee
Huzur Hakkı

filter.insuranceId
array — Company setting IDs for SGK workplaces.

filter.taxId
array — Company setting IDs for tax departments.

filter.expenseCenterId
array — Company setting IDs for expense centers.

filter.units
array of arrays — Organizational unit item IDs. Each inner array is AND-ed.

"units": [["branch_item_id"], ["department_item_id"]]

Response
{
  "error": false,
  "data": {
    "columns": { "firstName": "Ad", "lastName": "Soyad", "..." : "..." },
    "dynamicColumns": {
      "benefits": { "<type>": { "label": "Yemek Yardımı", "grossLabel": "Brüt", "netLabel": "Net" } },
      "deductions": { "<type>": { "label": "İcra", "netLabel": "Net", "turnoverLabel": "Devir" } },
      "promotions": { "<code class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml'>": { "label": "05510" } },
      "units": { "<unit_id>": { "label": "Departman" } }
    },
    "rows": [ { "..." : "..." } ],
    "meta": { "total": 150, "payrollId": "uuid", "year": 2026, "month": 1 }
  }
}

columns
Static key→label map for all fixed fields. Use as table headers.

dynamicColumns
Column definitions that vary per company/payroll:

benefits — Each has gross and net values in row data

deductions — Each has net; allowance and enforcement also have turnover

promotions — SGK incentive codes; row data has the amount per code

units — Organizational units; row data has unit item name or null

rows
Array of employee objects. Key fields per row:

Group
Fields

Personal
personId, registrationNumber, firstName, lastName

Payroll
payrollYear, payrollMonth, hasPayslip, payrollStatus, errorMessage

Employee
idNumber, gender, disabilityLevel, isRetired, governingLaw, specialityCode, employmentStartDate, employmentTerminationDate, terminationReason, employmentType, sgkWorkplace, sgkWorkplaceNumber, taxDepartment, taxNumber, expenseCenter, expenseCenterNumber, iban

Units
units — object keyed by unit ID → item name

Income
wageType, salaryPeriod, baseWage, dailyWage, payableDay, wageGross, wageNet, overtimeGrossTotal, overtimeNetTotal, benefitsGrossTotal, benefitsNetTotal, allIncomesGrossTotal

SGK
workDay, restDay, publicHoliday, paidLeaveDay, unpaidLeaveDay, sickDay, otherMissingDays, workHours, sgkDay, baseSgkWage, sgkExemptionTotal, sgkMonthlyTopWage, carryoverFromLastMonth, usedFromCarryover, carryoverToNextMonth, sgkMonthlyBase, employeeSgkPay, employeeUnemploymentPay, employeeSgkTotal, employerSgkPay, employerUnemploymentPay, employerSgkTotal, employerSgkTotalWithoutPromotions

Income Tax
incomeTaxBase, disabilityExemption, incomeTaxExemptionTotal, previousMonthCumulativeTaxBase, cumulativeIncomeTaxBase, incomeTaxRatios, incomeTaxMonthlyBase, incomeTaxAmountBeforeMinimumWageExemption, minimumWageIncomeTaxExemption, incomeTaxAmount, incomeTaxExemptionByPromotions, incomeTaxPayment

Stamp Tax
stampTaxBase, stampTaxExemption, stampTaxMonthlyWage, stampTaxAmountBeforeMinimumWageExemption, minimumWageStampTaxExemption, stampTaxAmount, stampTaxExemptionByPromotions, stampTaxPayment

Deductions
taxCutTotal, privateDeductionsTotal, inKindTotal, allDeductionsTotal

Promotions
promotions (object keyed by code → amount), promotionsTotal

Wage
monthlyWageGross, monthlyWageNet

Employer Cost
paidAmount, employeeCostTotal, totalIncentives, employeeCostTotalWithPromotions

Overtime
restDayHour, restDayGross, restDayNet, publicHolidayOvertimeHour, publicHolidayOvertimeGross, publicHolidayOvertimeNet, workDayOvertimeHour, workDayOvertimeGross, workDayOvertimeNet

Severance
severanceGross, severanceNet, noticeGross, noticeNet, remainingLeaveDaysGross, remainingLeaveDaysNet

Benefits
benefits — object keyed by type → { gross, net }

Deductions
deductions — object keyed by type → { net } or { net, turnover }

Calculation
calculationDate (ISO 8601), calculationId

meta

Field
Type
Description

total
integer
Number of employees returned

payrollId
string
Payroll run ID

year
integer
Payroll year

month
integer
Payroll month (1-12)

Examples
All employees, no filter:

{}

Completed monthly employees:

{ "filter": { "status": ["ended"], "salaryPeriod": ["monthly"] } }

Search + specific SGK workplace:

{ "filter": { "search": "Melih", "insuranceId": ["setting_id_here"] } }

Employees needing recalculation:

{ "filter": { "status": ["changedColumns"] } }

Errors

Code
Description

401
Invalid or missing API token

422
Validation error (invalid payroll ID, invalid filter values)
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

List Payroll Periods
Returns the list of payroll runs (bordro dönemleri) for a given year. Use this to get payroll IDs before calling the View Payroll Sheet endpoint.

Scope: payroll:list

Request
GET /v2/payroll/list?year=2026

Query Parameters

Parameter
Type
Required
Description

year
integer
No
Filter by year. Max value: current year + 1. Defaults to current year if omitted.

Response
{
  "error": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "abc123def456ghi789jkl012mno345pq",
      "period": "2026-01-01 00:00:00",
      "year": 2026,
      "month": 1,
      "total": 150,
      "payslips": 120,
      "errors": 2,
      "employerCost": 1250000.50,
      "updatedAt": "2026-01-15"
    },
    {
      "id": "rst678uvw901xyz234abc567def890ghi",
      "period": "2026-02-01 00:00:00",
      "year": 2026,
      "month": 2,
      "total": 152,
      "payslips": 0,
      "errors": 5,
      "employerCost": 1280000.75,
      "updatedAt": "2026-02-14"
    }
  ]
}

Response Fields

Field
Type
Description

id
string
Payroll run ID. Use this as {id} in /v2/payroll-sheet/view/{id}.

period
string
Period start date as datetime string (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss)

year
integer
Payroll year

month
integer
Payroll month (1-12)

total
integer
Total number of included employees

payslips
integer
Number of generated payslips

errors
integer
Number of failed calculations

employerCost
number
Total employer cost (sum of all included employees)

updatedAt
string
Last update date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Examples
All payroll for current year (default):

GET /v2/payroll/list

Filter by year:

GET /v2/payroll/list?year=2026

Errors

Code
Description

401
Invalid or missing API token

422
Validation error (e.g. year is not an integer or exceeds max value)
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Welcome to Public API reference of Kolay!

This documentation is here to help you easily integrate your existing apps to Kolay. In order to use this API you need to have an API Token ready. If you don't have an existing API Token you can visit the following link and create one for your needs https://app.kolayik.com/settings/developer-settings If you have any technical questions you can contact us via apisupport@kolay.io
